subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): onModelDiagnosticEvent for trusted model.* events

question: Should external plugins consume model telemetry through the existing typed hook dispatcher, or should OpenClaw permanently support a separate process-wide diagnostics subscription with different access semantics?
rationale: Both directions are implementable and proven, but selecting the permanent public Plugin SDK boundary determines compatibility obligations, diagnostics coupling, and whether provider/session telemetry is scoped by plugin identity.

options.title: Extend typed hooks
options.body: Keep one canonical hook system, add only missing correlation or failover fields, and apply provider or conversation access controls there.

options.title: Approve diagnostics subscription
options.body: Accept `onModelDiagnosticEvent` as a permanent cross-provider observability API and explicitly approve its unscoped, non-integrity trust contract.

options.title: Narrow to provider usage
options.body: Revive a provider-owned opt-in usage feed similar to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97892 and handle failover through a separate typed hook.

recommendation.title: Extend typed hooks
recommendation.body: Keep one canonical hook system, add only missing correlation or failover fields, and apply provider or conversation access controls there.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent maintainer-associated proposal directly evaluated the competing provider-scoped contract and its diagnostics, ownership, and access boundaries.
